purpose: Feeds the real update check releases with missing, wrong-key and bad signatures and a good one; checks the changelog and the yes before any core change; injects a failing health check and checks the rollback; hashes the Squire owner's folder through update and rollback; kills an install at every step it names and checks Squire comes back on a healthy version, and changes Claude Code outside Squire and checks it is noticed and checked.
title: Signed update, changelog and yes, rollback, and the Squire owner's folder untouched
